channel.title: Projects on Raj Shah
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Raj Shah

item.title: LensDB: Compressed Learned Index for Traffic Video Analytics
item.description: A compressed learned index for surveillance and traffic video that decouples ingestion from interactive querying.

item.title: TokenSmith: Agentic RAG system on Local LLM
item.description: A retrieval-augmented QA pipeline for technical textbooks, designed to reduce “semantic miss” failures by combining sparse keyword matching with dense embedding retrieval.

item.title: CardEst: Cardinality Estimation Benchmark & Optimization
item.description: A comprehensive benchmarking framework for database cardinality estimation, implementing traditional and feedback-driven estimators on the JOB benchmark.

item.title: MapReduce Infrastructure
item.description: A distributed, fault-tolerant MapReduce implementation built from scratch in C++ with gRPC and multithreading capabilities.

item.title: Classmate AI
item.description: A cross-platform mobile application that provides real-time lecture transcription, AI-powered summaries, and intelligent Q&A to enhance learning efficiency.
